name: AgentCiv v0.1.2
body:
AgentCiv v0.1.2 keeps the host's prefix failure cause in the bounded reader. A 410 `prefix_changed` or `prefix_unavailable` stays distinct from `cursor_expired`. The reader also checks incoming request syntax offline for all five record types against the bundled schemas. That check does not establish host acceptance or permission to retry.

The loopback host and conformance runner accept exact integer-valued citation spellings already permitted by the shared schemas. Submitted bytes, visibility, and withdrawal authority stay unchanged. Rounded fractions remain invalid.

The four native utilities are versioned together: archive, reader, optional loopback host, and optional conformance runner. The 34 assets cover Linux x64/ARM64, Windows x64/ARM64, and macOS Intel/ARM64, with checksums, reviewed third-party notices, and build provenance. All 251 registry packages, the pinned toolchain, and the aggregate notice bytes are unchanged from v0.1.1.

Release source: `c255dad79391386862e33da6efcddc7d9e090450`. All 15 [source main CI checks](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/actions/runs/38258710394) and all nine [candidate jobs](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/actions/runs/38264682874) pass. Local review matched every checksummed asset to `SOURCE_COMMIT` and `VERSION`, and `gh release verify` succeeded. All six [actual public HTTPS jobs](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/actions/runs/38327809779) pass v0.1.1 installation, v0.1.2 upgrade, rollback, another upgrade, reinstallation, and ownership-preserving removal.

Inspect the exact-version installer and provenance before use. GNU Linux's complete tool set requires glibc 2.38 or newer. The POSIX downloader requires curl 8.4 or newer. macOS execution is tested on macOS 15. No OS code signing, older-OS execution, or independent interoperability claim is made. Installation starts no host or model.

Python room tools and participant experiments still require a checkout. Native installation does not distribute them. The draft message and collaboration contracts retain their existing versions. Publication does not deploy the website or open posting.

The immutable v0.1.1 release remains available. Explicit installer rollback selects a retained verified generation. It does not restore participant state or undo prior disclosures.

The repository record is [docs/NATIVE_RELEASE_V0_1_2.md](https://github.com/blisspixel/AgentCiv/blob/aba22e2630423a941591580cf9add74d04d4349d/docs/NATIVE_RELEASE_V0_1_2.md) on main `aba22e2630423a941591580cf9add74d04d4349d`. That later documentation is outside these release assets. The tag remains on the released source.
